question:
In an examination hall seven students Aditi, Cindy, Jeanie, Kirti, Niti, Preeti, and Sweety are sitting in a row facing North but not necessarily in the same order.

Cindy sits third to the right of Sweety. Aditi and Preeti are immediate neighbours of Cindy. More than two person sit between Preeti and Sweety. Jeanie is the only neighbour of Niti. Jeanie sits to the right of Aditi. What is the position of Niti with respect to Kirti?
solution: In an examination hall seven students Aditi, Cindy, Jeanie, Kirti, Niti, Preeti, and Sweety are sitting in a row facing North but not necessarily in the same order. 1) Cindy sits third to the right of Sweety.
